description: Counts rising-edge pulses up and/or down within configurable limits. Supports clamp and wrap overflow modes.

inputs.name: Increment
inputs.description: Pulse input. Each rising edge increments the counter value by 1.

inputs.name: Decrement
inputs.description: Pulse input. Each rising edge decrements the counter value by 1.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge resets the counter to the configured start value. Dominant input.

outputs.name: At upper limit
outputs.description: True when the counter value equals the configured upper limit.

outputs.name: At lower limit
outputs.description: True when the counter value equals the configured lower limit.

config.name: Start value
config.description: Initial counter value and value restored on reset. Must be within the configured limits.

config.name: Lower limit
config.description: Minimum counter value. Must be less than the upper limit.

config.name: Upper limit
config.description: Maximum counter value. Must be greater than the lower limit.

config.name: Overflow mode
config.description: Behavior when the counter reaches a limit. Clamp stops at the limit. Wrap continues from the opposite limit.

state.name: Previous increment state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the increment input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous decrement state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the decrement input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous reset state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the reset input to detect rising edges.
